rule: OFCs describe destination ecosystems; TFCs describe an explicit applicant/household/scenario snapshot. Neither proves or mutates the other.

rows.allowed_context: User-declared occupation may suggest this OFC; show ecosystem state beside independent route/earnings results.
rows.conflict_explanation: A strong ecosystem can coexist with no supported route match; a route match can coexist with OFC insufficient evidence.

rows.allowed_context: User-declared engineering/science context may suggest the OFC and bounded licensing/route checks.
rows.conflict_explanation: Ecosystem scale says nothing about regulator recognition or route eligibility.

rows.allowed_context: User-declared health/care occupation may suggest the care-sector OFC and a profession-specific licensing check.
rows.conflict_explanation: A strong care-sector signal may coexist with conditional or unmet physician/nurse licensing requirements.

rows.allowed_context: User-declared finance/insurance occupation may suggest the narrower OFC.
rows.conflict_explanation: The OFC's narrow industry signal and a route result answer different questions.

rows.allowed_context: User-declared trade/construction context may suggest the OFC and bounded regulator/route checks.
rows.conflict_explanation: A strong trades/construction route in OFC evidence does not satisfy certification or immigration rules.

rows.allowed_context: A declared physical-sciences/engineering study interest may suggest this research-university ecosystem OFC.
rows.conflict_explanation: A strong research ecosystem may coexist with no matching programme or supported post-study route.

rows.allowed_context: A declared mathematics/computer-science study interest may suggest this OFC.
rows.conflict_explanation: Country research strength is independent of an institution/course/route match.

rows.allowed_context: A declared biomedical/health study interest may suggest this OFC; future licensing remains a separate check.
rows.conflict_explanation: Research strength does not establish clinical training or later professional recognition.

rows.allowed_context: A declared life/earth-sciences study interest may suggest this OFC.
rows.conflict_explanation: Research-university evidence and applicant feasibility remain independent.
